promptSteps.prompt: Dispatchers want to hand a specific job to a worker instead of taking whatever comes next. Please add `--job <job-id>` to `queuedesk claim`, which claims exactly that job when the caller can see it and it is still queued. A job the caller cannot see answers the way a missing job does, exit code 2; a job that is not queued is an invalid transition, exit code 3; a malformed identifier is a usage error, exit code 1. Every existing invocation must keep behaving exactly as it does today, including `claim` with no flag. Run `npm test` in the project root to check your work.
